final: SELECT AVG(r.ratio) AS avg_file_size_to_length_ratio, SUM(r.track_count) AS total_count, AVG(r.track_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_difference FROM (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name) AS r JOIN (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_count FROM (SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name)) AS a ON a.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE r.track_count > a.avg_count
